## Issue summary

Sprint delivery unit covering end-to-end capability for Incident Recording.

**Project:** great-ptw-loto-ai-app
**Sprint:** SP-06.01 (Execution order: 8)
**Layer:** SP
**Priority:** Urgent (1)

## Positive test cases

- All child issues (DB/INF/BE/FE/MOB) completed
- End-to-end workflow demonstrated across web and API
- Regression suite passes for prior milestones

## Negative test cases

- Partial delivery merged without integration proof
- Critical defects deferred without approval
- Cross-module regressions in permit lifecycle

## Acceptance criteria

- Sprint objective met per Implementation Plan
- Demo recorded or documented
- Stakeholder sign-off captured

## Definition of Done

- All child issues Done
- CI green on main
- Release notes updated

---

## Existing notes

## Sprint objective

The objective of this sprint is to provide a structured mechanism for recording operational incidents immediately after they occur.

**Type:** Feature Sprint
**Estimated duration:** 2 weeks
**Functional requirements:** FR-INC-001 to FR-INC-004

## Core scope

Incidents can be reported; Near misses can be recorded; Unsafe conditions can be reported; Evidence can be uploaded; Incidents can be linked to permits and equipment; N… (truncated, use `get_issue` for full description)
